injuries.name: Jordyn Tyson
injuries.note: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that Tyson (hamstring) traveled to Paris in advance of Sunday's game against the Steelers, NewOrleans.football reports.

injuries.name: Kool-Aid McKinstry
injuries.note: Saints head coach Kellen Moore stated McKinstry (illness) exited Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants due to a migraine, Jeff Nowak of The Big 870 New Orleans reports.

injuries.name: Quincy Riley
injuries.note: Riley sustained a neck injury in the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

injuries.name: Cesar Ruiz
injuries.note: Ruiz (knee) won't return to Sunday's game against the Giants, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Nathan Shepherd
injuries.note: Shepherd (illness) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Giants.

injuries.name: Zach Wilson
injuries.note: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Saints' emergency third quarterback against the Giants on Sunday.
